name: Waiting
source:
You have been ordered by the royal family to hunt down and kill the vampire hiding in Fontaine Castle. Failure will result in the repossession of your farm and land as penance for defiant treason against King Markus and his decree.

What are you waiting for?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/waiting]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
王室命令你追捕并杀死隐藏在方丹城堡的吸血鬼。失败将导致你的农场和土地被收回，作为对马库斯国王及其法令的叛逆行为的忏悔。

你还在等什么？

[来自[url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/waiting]itch.io[/url]]
